getCalendarEvents.description: Get calendar events for a user in a specific date range. Returns events from all calendars associated with the user plus shared/public calendars.

user.description: Person's name to look up calendars for (e.g., 'Craig')

getUpcomingEvents.description: Get upcoming calendar events for a user over the next N days. Convenience wrapper that defaults to 7 days.

user.description: Person's name to look up calendars for (e.g., 'Craig')

days.description: Number of days to look ahead (default: 7)

listUserCalendars.description: List all calendar labels configured for a user. Shows calendar names grouped by server, without exposing URLs or credentials.

user.description: Person's name to list calendars for (e.g., 'Craig')

lookupContact.description: Look up contacts by any identifier: name, email, handle, nickname, etc. Returns ranked results.

query.description: Name, email address, Bluesky handle, Discord name, or any other identifier to search for

lookupContactId.description: Get the identifier value(s) for a specific contact on a given platform (e.g., their email address or Bluesky handle).

requestContactCreate.description: Request creation of a new contact. Requires admin approval before the contact is saved.

identifiers.description: At least one identifier for the contact

requestContactUpdate.description: Request an update to an existing contact. Requires admin approval before changes are saved.

personId.description: The personId of the contact to update (e.g., "craig-hughes")

addIdentifiers.description: New identifiers to add to the contact

removeIdentifiers.description: Identifiers to remove from the contact

notes.description: New notes for the contact (replaces existing notes)

listContacts.description: List all known contacts in the address book.

getUnreadOverview.description: Get a high-level overview of unread messages across all channels. Returns counts only, no message content.

getChannelSummary.description: Get an AI-generated summary of unread messages in a channel, plus message metadata for selective reading. Accepts channel ID or #channel-name format.

fetchMessages.description: Fetch full content of specific messages by ID. Use after reviewing channel summary to get details. Accepts channel ID or #channel-name format.

messageIds.description: Array of message IDs to fetch

markAsRead.description: Mark specific messages as read. Updates the checkpoint for the channel. Accepts channel ID or #channel-name format.

messageIds.description: Array of message IDs to mark as read

markChannelRead.description: Mark all messages in a channel as read. Updates the checkpoint to the latest message. Accepts channel ID or #channel-name format.

analyzeVideoFromUrl.description: Download and analyze a video from a URL. Extracts scene-based frames, metadata, and subtitles/transcription.

url.description: Video URL or HLS playlist URL

outputDir.description: Directory to save video files and frames

analyzeLocalVideo.description: Analyze a video file already saved to disk. Extracts scene-based frames, metadata, and subtitles/transcription.

videoPath.description: Path to the local video file

outputDir.description: Directory to save analysis output (frames, metadata)

alt.description: Alt text description of the video

getVideoFrames.description: Extract additional frames from a previously downloaded video. Use to focus on specific time ranges.

videoPath.description: Path to the local video file

generateSpectrogramFromAudio.description: Generate an audio spectrogram image from a video or audio file. Useful for identifying speech patterns and audio content.

filePath.description: Path to the local video or audio file

storeSelf.description: Store self-knowledge in identity or state layer. Saving with the same name will replace existing content.

layer.description: Layer: identity (core beliefs/values) or state (current context)

storeUserMemory.description: Store user-specific memory. Saving with the same userId and name will replace existing content.

logEvent.description: Log an event to the events layer

eventType.description: Type of event (e.g., conversation, decision, learning)

search.description: Search memories by tag with optional filters

tags.description: Tags to search for (AND semantics — items must have all tags)

startDate.description: Filter: items updated on or after this ISO8601 datetime

endDate.description: Filter: items updated on or before this ISO8601 datetime

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

startDate.description: Filter: items updated on or after this ISO8601 datetime

endDate.description: Filter: items updated on or before this ISO8601 datetime

listTags.description: List all tags with their usage counts

deleteMemory.description: Delete a memory at the specified path. Returns the deleted content as confirmation.

updateTags.description: Add or remove tags on an existing memory without changing its content.

path.description: Memory path to update tags on

addTags.description: Tags to add to the memory

removeTags.description: Tags to remove from the memory

memorySemantic.description: Semantic search over memories by content similarity. Use the `search` tool for tag-based filtering instead. The query is embedded the same way memory content is, so phrase it in the form a matching memory would take — declarative statements rather than questions.

query.description: Natural language query to search for semantically similar memories

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (default: 5)

getPersonContext.description: Fetch cross-platform interaction history for a person. Returns recent messages, emails, and social interactions.

identifier.description: Name, email, handle, or any identifier for the person

getRandomArticle.description: Fetch a random Wikipedia article summary. Returns structured JSON with title, extract, description, thumbnail URL, and full article URL.

getArticle.description: Fetch a Wikipedia article's full source content by title. Returns JSON with title, source (wikitext), and metadata.
